read: Abstract, background, Results CDR definition and nuisance-confounding discussion, reviewed 2026-09-29.
mechanism: MAST includes the fraction of detected genes per cell as a nuisance covariate; it can reflect both technical and biological variation.
adaptation: Add standardized mapped-gene CDR to linear-ridge detection regression with latent ridge fixed1 and CDR ridge.1/1. Hold observed donor CDR fixed when forecasting. Positive heads and flow unchanged. Not MAST logistic/Bayesian inference or a published forecasting method.
limitations: CDR may remove genuine biology, includes the response gene in its fraction, and depends on mapped gene coverage. No causal interpretation, measured dropout rates or future CDR are supplied. All normalization and fitting past-only.
